weak_label_policy: Provider H/A only, including ball-missing observations. Unknown stays X. At fractional source ticks require both adjacent provider labels to agree. No carrier-visible filter. No D target is inferred.
weak_loss: Conditional H/A cross entropy; D logit excluded, unknown targets ignored.
inference: Frozen observation-loss gate, expert strength 1, parent boundaries and decoder unchanged. Normalization remains the initial model's external training normalization.
selection: Joint mean of strong three-view spell F1 and detected-only weak H/A macro F1, with native guard and strong mean no more than 0.01 below initial. Weak H/A accuracy and missing-ball conditional H/A accuracy must remain within 0.005 of natural-v1 reference; unchanged initial is always eligible as fallback.
policy: All parameter/model selection external only. Existing development matches were previously opened; this is exploratory, not an independent or competition score. Real broadcast weak supervision does not establish dead-ball accuracy. Preserve all prior frozen bundles and CSVs.
